name: Sözlü Öğrenme / Kodlama Zayıflığı
definition: Canlı/sözlü bilgiyi anında işleyip yerleştirememe. Yazılı + tekrarlı bilgiyi öğrenme. 'Defalarca okuyup kafama sokmam gerekir.'

mechanisms.primary: Encoding deficit — problem at input stage, NOT retention
secondary: Passive exposure insufficient — needs active retrieval
Working memory overload during live speech
Split-attention: listening + understanding + storing simultaneously fails
mechanisms.key_finding: DLD research: encoding not retention is problematic. Self-testing with feedback lessens deficit.

research_sources.finding: Adults with DLD: encoding deficits impede word learning. Encoding performance predicts vocabulary. NOT retention problem.
DLD word learning: focus on ENCODING phase. Shorter words, repeated retrieval, direct instruction, reconsolidation as relative strength.
Retrieval practice (RSR) > repeated study for verb learning in DLD. Both immediate and 1-week retention. Both DLD and TD benefit.
Retrieval practice better retention than more study for DLD children. Shared book reading context.
Repeated testing > repeated study for 1-week retention. Foundational retrieval practice evidence.
Retrieval practice vs reading: g=0.50 [0.42, 0.58] from 159 effect sizes.
Retrieval practice vs all other: g=0.61 [0.58, 0.65]. Stronger with complex content and feedback.
Verbal + visual = two memory traces. 25-40% better recall. Concrete words > abstract.
Split-attention effect: integrating text+diagrams reduces cognitive load. Physical integration > mental integration.
Spaced retrieval practice vs massed: g=0.74. Two desirable difficulties combined.
Spaced practice for math: g=0.28 robust. Testing vs restudy: g=0.18 (less robust for math).
9 STEM courses: spaced retrieval practice mean improvement 2.06%, significant but variable (I2=89%).
Learners forced to split attention between disparate sources → heavy extraneous load. Physical integration facilitates learning.
Worked examples reduce extraneous load for novices. Replace problem-solving with studying examples, then fade.
Verbal learning + consolidation positively related to spelling. Oral rehearsal benefits encoding.
Retrieval + criterion-based training effective for DLD word learning. Continue until multiple successful retrievals.

solutions.name: Sözlü → Yazılı Boru Hattı
solutions.protocol: DİNLE → HEMEN NOT → AKŞAM ÖZET → KENDİNE SOR → TEKRAR. Asla sadece dinleme.

solutions.name: Retrieval Practice (Kendine Test)
solutions.protocol: Notu kapat → 'Bu neydi?' yaz → Aç kontrol et → Yanlışları tekrar et. Pasif okuma YAPMA.

solutions.name: Dual Coding
solutions.protocol: Her konu: 3 madde yazı + 1 şema/diagram çiz. Sözlüyü görsel-yazılı forma çevir.

solutions.name: Spaced Repetition
solutions.protocol: Gün 0 öğren → Gün 1 tekrar → Gün 3 → Gün 7 → Gün 14. Aralıklı, aynı gün 10 kez okuma değil.

solutions.name: Ders Kaydı + Durdurma
solutions.evidence: MODERATE — removes time pressure from encoding
solutions.protocol: Dersi kaydet. Durdur, not al, tekrar dinle. Kendi temponda kodla.

solutions.name: Worked Examples
solutions.protocol: Problem çözmek yerine çözülmüş örneklere bak. Sonra benzerini dene. Rehberi azalt.

solutions.name: Feynman Tekniği
solutions.protocol: Öğrendiğini kendi kelimelerinle anlat (yazılı). Anlatamıyorsan öğrenmemişsin.

daily_protocol.during_learning: Sözlü → yazılı boru hattı. Not al, durdur, tekrar.
daily_protocol.spaced: Anki veya takvim ile Gün 1, 3, 7, 14 tekrar

weekly: Kaç konuyu sadece dinledin vs boru hattı kullandın

interactions.note: Sözlü öğrenme zayıflığı ≠ öğrenememe. Yazılı + retrieval ile öğreniyorsun.
